items.title: Concern as private health giant wins access to public emergency patients
items.description: A trial to ease pressure on a public emergency department has raised concerns a multi-million-dollar company is getting a special deal.

items.title: Amazon sued over alleged unfair terms on streaming service
items.description: The consumer watchdog is suing Amazon over allegedly having unfair contract terms for its Prime streaming service.

items.title: Are the wheels falling off the AI investment boom?
items.description: Overshadowing the tumult that is global politics has been a financial boom beyond almost anything witnessed before, focused entirely on the perceived benefits wrought by a brave new world of AI that threatens to up-end our lives.

items.title: Live: Paraguay knocks Germany out after incredible penalty shootout drama
items.description: Paraguay knocks Germany out of the 2026 World Cup, beating the four-time world champions Germany in a penalty shootout, while Brazil's Gabriel Martinelli scores in the 96th minute to break Japanese hearts. Follow live.

items.title: 'Systemic racism' tip of the iceberg in buried reef authority review
items.description: The damning results of a review into the agency tasked with managing the Great Barrier Reef, an area bigger than New Zealand and home to 70 traditional owner groups, has never before seen the light of day.

items.title: Live: Treasurer 'willing to engage' on super for under-18s
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers says he's open to discussing a guarantee for superannuation to be paid for teenage workers but stresses that's not the government's focus at the moment. Follow live.

items.title: 'We don't fully understand': The footy risk few parents grasp
items.description: Contact is an essential part of footy, but there is growing evidence it can also be a grave threat to the health and welfare of its players. Experts say the AFL should be acting now to protect current and future players.

items.title: Social media giants face fines for failing to hand over documents
items.description: Labor wants to double the fines for tech giants who refuse to hand over documents that could prove they are failing to enforce Australia’s social media age ban.

items.title: Midwife hit with $70,000 foreign investment tax after moving to Australia
items.description: A British midwife who migrated to Australia to work at a regional hospital during statewide staff shortages is calling for changes to the law after being slugged $70,000 by state and federal authorities for the purchase of her home.

items.title: Australia helping seven in Venezuela as earthquake death toll rises
items.description: Australia provides "consular assistance" to seven people after the Venezuela's two earthquakes, Foreign Affairs Minister Penny Wong has confirmed.

items.title: Breaking: Multiple injuries, driver unaccounted for in truck-stop crash inferno
items.description: Explosions and multiple injuries as up to seven semi-trailers are destroyed after trucks collide on the Hume Highway then veer into a rest area near Goulburn.

items.title: Sons remember 'loving' mum after Airbnb guest found guilty of killing her
items.description: Maree Vermont's sons say they never thought hosting Airbnb guests would be dangerous for their mother, who was proud of the home she had built.

items.title: Ill-fated midnight mountain walk in freezing conditions led to 12-day search
items.description: The NSW coroner praises emergency services for "persistence" during the 12-day search for a hiker who set off on an ill-fated midnight mountain walk in sub-zero temperatures while wearing sandals.

items.title: Multi-million-dollar giveaway club banned by NSW regulator
items.description: One of Australia's biggest "rewards clubs" has been banned from running any gaming activity in New South Wales for 18 months after allegedly breaking the law.

items.title: BalletTok, blackface and nudes: Inside the world of professional ballet
items.description: Ariane Beeston, the author of an acclaimed memoir detailing her experience with postpartum psychosis, has penned her first work of fiction, Don't Forget to Smile.

items.title: Will you raise the white flag on these tricky flag questions?
items.description: How many stars are there on the US flag? And how many stars are on the Europe flag?

items.title: More Australians are doing their own tax returns and making these mistakes
items.description: With side hustles, working from home, crypto investments, renting out rooms and receiving income through digital platforms or apps, experts say people are at greater risk of making errors with their tax.

items.title: NDIS shell company boom sparks crackdown
items.description: The federal government says it is moving to crack down on the growing trade in "off-the-shelf" NDIS providers.

items.title: Live: ASX headed for cautious start, Wall Street jumps as AI-related stocks rebound
items.description: The Australian share market is likely to start its day relatively flat despite a rebound in oil prices ahead of the next round of US-Iran peace talks. On Wall Street, the Dow Jones Industrial Average hit a record high. Follow live.

items.title: Strait of Hormuz strikes likely to disrupt shipping again
items.description: Fresh attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz have exposed the fragility of the 60-day ceasefire deal between the US and Iran, which was meant to allow ships to transit through the waterway again.

items.title: Bondi terror attack survivor received 'influx of hate' hours after shooting
items.description: Deepfake and altered images depicting a Bondi Beach terror attack survivor holding an Academy Award while covered in blood spread "like wildfire" online just hours after the shooting, a royal commission has heard.

items.title: Court rejects Trump's final bid to overturn E Jean Carroll verdict
items.description: The US Supreme Court declined to hear US President Donald Trump's bid to overturn a $5 million USD verdict in a case in which a jury found him liable for sexually abusing and defaming E Jean Carroll.

items.title: Police hold 'real concern' about anonymous letters sent to politicians
items.description: Police have asked for the community's assistance to identify the author targeting parliamentarians and religious organisations, who goes by 'Scorpio' or 'Bullit'.

items.title: PM-in-waiting Andy Burnham lays out plan to fix 'broken' British politics
items.description: Andy Burnham, the British MP tipped to replace the outgoing prime minister Sir Keir Starmer, promised "radical change" to the nation's "broken" political system as he laid out his vision to lead the country on Monday.

items.title: ABC presenter Trevor Chappell to hang up mic after 26 years
items.description: After decades of keeping night owls and shift workers company on ABC radio across Australia, Overnights presenter Trevor Chappell decides to call it a day at the age of 65.
